//: Exertion (07 §12): a pool drained by fighting, for those who have one. Every blow that lands from someone in an aggressive stance costs stamina (the pool of `traits.json`); out of breath, the stance is dropped. Someone with no stamina pool is not affected.
doc: A blow that lands from someone in an aggressive stance costs them 5 stamina.
Someone in an aggressive stance whose stamina falls below a quarter drops the stance.
